online.reasons.joker_eliminated: The Joker was voted out and won alone.

online.reasons.none_correct: The group chose correctly and won together.
online.reasons.none_missed: Nobody was an imposter, but the group chose another option.
online.reasons.reverse_civil_eliminated: The only player who knew the word was voted out.

online.reasons.undercover_eliminated: The player with the minority word was voted out.
online.reasons.undercover_survived: The player with the minority word survived.
online.reasons.imposter_eliminated: An actual imposter was voted out.
online.reasons.imposter_survived: No actual imposter was voted out.

online.reasons.guess_wrong: The final guess was wrong, so the civilians won.
